description: This file defines the SharedFormula class used in the PHPSpreadsheet library for handling shared formulas within XLSX files during spreadsheet reading operations.

classes.name: SharedFormula
classes.description: Represents a shared formula in the XLSX reading process, encapsulating the master cell address and the formula string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SharedFormula instance with the master cell reference and the formula string.

methods.name: master
methods.description: Returns the master cell reference associated with this shared formula.

methods.name: formula
methods.description: Returns the formula string associated with this shared formula.
